name: Danish Aerospace and Defence Co
summary: Danish Aerospace & Defence Co. A/S is a space-technology company, which engages in the provision of technology solutions for the purpose of exploration of space and other extreme environments. It involves in the design, development, and manufacture of medical monitoring and exercise equipment, as well as support in connection with preparations for and completion of human space flights. The company was founded in August 1988 and is headquartered in Odense, Denmark.
